special_abilities.name: Diabolical Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes three Ice Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

actions.name: Ice Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target can’t take a Bonus Action or Reaction, its Speed decreases by 10 feet, and it can move or take one action on its turn, not both. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the devil’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Wall (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The devil casts Wall of Ice (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The imp casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat (Speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

special_abilities.name: Succubus Form
special_abilities.desc: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.

actions.name: Restless Touch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: The incubus casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

actions.name: At Will
actions.desc: Disguise Self, Etherealness

actions.name: 1/Day Each
actions.desc: Dream, Hypnotic Pattern

bonus_actions.name: Nightmare (Recharge 6)
bonus_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

special_abilities.name: Air Form
special_abilities.desc: The stalker can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

special_abilities.name: Invisibility
special_abilities.desc: The stalker has the Invisible condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

actions.name: Wind Swipe
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Vortex
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker’s space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can’t cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker’s turns.

special_abilities.name: Fire Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Bladed Arm
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fiery Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 36 (8d8) Fire damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot

special_abilities.name: Emanation originating from the mephit
special_abilities.desc: Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

actions.name: Fog Cloud (1/Day)
actions.desc: The mephit casts Fog Cloud, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (3d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
